raw_object.t: This is exactly why death as gain cannot remain an idea admired from a safe intellectual distance. It is not mind over matter — it is not a technique of positive thinking applied at the last moment to overpower natural terror. It must be your reality. Not a doctrine filed away for later, not a verse quoted at funerals, but the actual ground a person is standing on when the hour comes.
